Mobile Egress includes ZXing-C++ 3.1.1 and its Android wrapper.
Source: https://github.com/zxing-cpp/zxing-cpp/tree/v3.1.1
Artifact: io.github.zxing-cpp:android:3.1.1
License: Apache License 2.0; see zxing-cpp-LICENSE.txt in this directory.

ZXing-C++ contributors retain their copyrights. The detector is bundled in the
application and processes QR images on the phone. Mobile Egress does not send
camera images or decoded pairing invitations to an external decoding service.
